title: BAYHOST: Scholarships for students and young academics from Central, Eastern and Southeastern Europe for summer language courses
summary: Summer school grants for German language courses at Bavarian higher education institutions for students and young academics from selected Central, Eastern and Southeastern European countries.

degree_levels.notes: Target group includes undergraduates, graduates and young scientists.

institutions.notes: Courses take place at a Bavarian higher education institution.

nationality.notes: Applicants must be a national of one of the eligible countries.

residence.notes: Scholarships are for courses on-site in Bavaria, Germany. Applicants must be enrolled or working in an eligible country at the time of application.

mandatory.text: citizenship of Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Kosovo, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Serbia, Slovenia or Ukraine
enrolled or working in an academic capacity at a higher education institution in one of the participating countries at the time of application
at least 2 semesters spent at a higher education institution, proven by grades
at least B1-level command of German
Candidates have reached legal age by the time of application

exceptions.text: Exceptions to the enrollment/employment rule may be made for Ukrainian citizens who are studying or working at higher education institutions in other countries.

funding.description: Includes the course fee, accommodation and spending money allowance or board at a Bavarian institution of higher education. Travel expenses, international health insurance, or visa fees will not be reimbursed.

application_rounds.notes: Please find the updated application deadlines on the external website.

steps.text: Check the website for application forms and procedure.

sources.title: BAYHOST: Scholarships for students and young academics from Central, Eastern and Southeastern Europe for summer language courses - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The programme funds international students for physically attending German language courses at a Bavarian institution of higher education in Germany.
